parsed.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
parsed.description: BioShake 是用于微孔板的加热振荡一体化实验室设备，可在设定温度下对孔板进行振荡混匀，并可通过锁板机构固定孔板以防移位；常用于酶促反应、孵育、混匀、样品制备等流程。
parsed.description_en: BioShake is an integrated microplate heater shaker used to mix microplates by orbital shaking while controlling the plate temperature. It can clamp/lock the plate to prevent movement during shaking, and is commonly used for incubation, enzymatic reactions, mixing, and sample preparation workflows.
